about.old: 괴담넷 is a Korean anonymous public forum within the ongoing narrative's world. Users include paranormal enthusiasts, skeptics, residents, investigators, anomaly-organization employees, witnesses, scammers and cranks. Treat them as people in this world, not story readers or game players.
about.new: {{#when {{equal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::gal}}}}괴담갤 is an ordinary Korean anonymous horror-story community within the ongoing narrative's world: a public board where regular people trade scary stories, eyewitness accounts, skeptical takes, everyday chatter and memes. Users are mostly ordinary residents, paranormal enthusiasts, skeptics, witnesses, scammers and cranks; anomaly-organization employees are rare and never identify themselves. Anomalies are rumor here, not common knowledge. Treat users as people in this world, not story readers or game players.{{/when}}{{#when {{equal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::wpf}}}}세계정치 게시판 (세정게, the World Politics Forum) is a Korean anonymous board nominally about world politics but in practice one of the internet's densest piles of conspiracy theories: the deep state, aliens, brain parasites, rigged lotteries, devices implanted in ears. Its public reputation is a gathering place for lunatics, and that reputation hides that a meaningful share of its content is true: many regulars are survivors of genuine anomalous encounters, and genuine testimony and fabrication look alike and are mocked alike. Users: floaters (tourists, mockers, one-time survivors), named regulars with fixed handles, a visible sub-moderator who deletes dangerous exposure posts, and people who insult the wiretapping agents they assume are reading. Anomaly-organization employees read it but never identify themselves. Treat users as people in this world, not story readers or game players.{{/when}}{{#when {{notequal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::gal}}}}{{#when {{notequal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::wpf}}}}괴담넷 is a Korean anonymous forum within the ongoing narrative's world used mostly by people inside the anomaly trade under aliases: Bureau agents, employees of the rival organizations, freelancers and association members, brokers, plus a few witnesses, scammers and cranks who wandered in. Nobody states their real name or affiliation outright, but everyone assumes everyone else is in the business, so jargon, rank bragging, job offers, salvage trades, warnings about sites and organizations, and insider gossip are normal. Treat users as people in this world, not story readers or game players.{{/when}}{{/when}}

tone.old: Default to Korean DCInside-style anonymous-community speech: informal, casual, slang, memes, blunt skepticism, rough jokes, occasional profanity and arguments; casual comments often omit final periods. Include serious firsthand accounts too. Vary ages, interests, sentence lengths and endings; do not make everyone a polite adviser or an exposition narrator. Strong criticism and disagreement need not be immediately moderated or resolved.
tone.new:
Default to Korean DCInside-style anonymous-community speech: informal, casual, slang, memes, blunt skepticism, rough jokes, occasional profanity and arguments; casual comments often omit final periods. Include serious firsthand accounts too. Vary ages, interests, sentence lengths and endings; do not make everyone a polite adviser or an exposition narrator. Strong criticism and disagreement need not be immediately moderated or resolved.
{{#when {{equal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::wpf}}}}Layer the World Politics Forum texture on top: paranoid certainty, punctuation inserted inside words to dodge automated scanning, jokes that regulars keep disappearing (they do), insults at the agents assumed to be reading, and absurd-sounding accounts that cannot be dismissed by their tone. Treat sincere survivor testimony and nonsense with the same mockery.{{/when}}{{#when {{notequal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::gal}}}}{{#when {{notequal::{{getvar::lb_cfg_lb-gn.style}}::wpf}}}}Keep the same anonymous-community base, then mix in trade flavor only where it fits the person: insider jargon (회수물, 봉쇄, 검은 양복, 그 회사), alias-hidden rank bragging, matter-of-fact job and trade posts, serious warnings and internal complaints, a tired veteran, a joking rookie, a haggling broker, an anonymous leaker. Not everyone sounds like a professional; most still sound like forum users.{{/when}}{{/when}}

topics.old: Use local rumors, eyewitness reports, skeptical questions, daily life, survival discussions, organizational gossip, scams, memes and unrelated mundane topics. Include at least one meme, joke, troll or humorous everyday topic. Do not force every thread to involve an anomaly.
